description: Scene-level split of the 24 FW-UAV6DPose validation scenes (never by frame). Phase 7b: YOLO-pose keypoint detector. The test scenes are never used for training, early stopping or any tuning.

background_groups.note: Scenes with consecutive ids share the same sky background (checked by eye on the first frame of every scene; scene 000111 looks like the 000086-000088 sky). The split keeps every group inside one split, so no background (and no neighbouring flight) is shared between train, val and test.

notes: Scene 000125 is not in the test split. It has a sequence cut between frames 76 and 77 (a jump of 217 m in the true translation), but every frame is consistent with its own mask (silhouette IoU 0.72-0.77 on both sides of the cut), so its labels are valid and it is used for training.
The test split reaches 443 m; the only frames beyond 450 m are in scenes 000122 and 000125 (group G), which stay in training.
